q1_issues.issue: "at ninety" is stored as a free-standing (Measure sk_founder_1 age 90 year) with no link to the dying eventuality, so it reads as an unconditioned standing age, and both the scale `age` and the unit `year` are supplied by the parser rather than stated, which the Measure rule requires (a stated gradable adjective, else the stated dimension noun).

q2_gaps: "at <number>" age-at-event adjunct — no construction ties a Measure to the time of an event, and no scale or unit is specified when the text states neither a gradable adjective nor a dimension noun

thematic-role assignment for a fixed multi-word idiom whose surface object is absorbed into the symbol (kick_the_bucket) — the Agent/Patient tests are stated for surface verbs with visible arguments, so the subject's role is undecidable without using the idiom's paraphrase
notes: Idiom handling is correct: one surface symbol keeping every word, no literal spill of bucket atoms, no genus, and no status atom for the bare simple present; Patient for the subject is a defensible resolution of the gap above.
